slides.title: DMPK and bioanalysis capabilities
slides.subtitle: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, Madison | August 2017
slides.notes: Copy of DMPK_Capabilities_081417. Changed the cover date only. Please don't send this one out until the matrix acceptance footnotes are updated (Helen).

slides.title: Who we are
bullets: DMPK and bioanalysis group established in Madison in 2003
Bioanalysis, in vitro ADME and early safety screening under one roof
Local scientific leadership retained since the 2008 acquisition
Studies run to a written protocol with matrix acceptance applied to every accession lot

slides.title: Assay menu and 2017 list prices
slides.notes: Prices as on the 2017 list. Quotes for multi-route PK are priced separately.

slides.title: Microsomal and hepatocyte CLint
bullets: Microsomal CLint run on two species per compound as standard
Hepatocyte depletion CLint for compounds where phase II or uptake is a concern
Clearance reported with units stated in the table header

bullets.text: µL/min/mg for microsomes, µL/min/10^6 cells for hepatocytes

slides.title: fu,p by equilibrium dialysis
bullets: Test article equilibrated between plasma and buffer compartments separated by a dialysis membrane
Unbound fraction reported for each species requested
Recovery checked against the matrix acceptance criteria before a result is accepted
Highly bound compounds flagged where the unbound fraction sits near the limit of the assay
slides.notes: Comment (Helen): the recovery wording needs the 2016 matrix acceptance limits, not the 2014 ones.

slides.title: Caco-2 flux and efflux
bullets: Bidirectional transport across monolayers, apical to basolateral and back
Monolayer integrity assessed with the transport controls; compromised monolayers are excluded from interpretation
Efflux ratio reported with the transport controls on the same worksheet

slides.title: DMSO-dilution solubility
bullets: Kinetic solubility from DMSO stock into aqueous buffer
Readout and sample handling specified in the assay protocol; limitations recorded with the result
Suitable for early triage of screening sets, not for formulation

slides.title: IKr and CYP work
bullets: IKr inhibition by whole-cell patch clamp on the standard cell line
Concentration response on each compound, reference compound on every run
bullets_right: Five-isoform DDI screen for first-pass CYP liability
CYP3A4 inhibition curves where the screen flags a concern

slides.title: Rat exposure and bioanalysis
bullets: Oral or IV PK in rat; the listed scope covers a single route with three animals, and paired-route work requires an agreed scope
Tandem-MS bioanalysis with matrix matched calibration standards
Exposure reported in ng·h/mL with the matrix and species stated
slides.notes: Comment (Helen): 'matrix acceptance footnotes' still missing on this slide. Add the rat plasma lot wording.

slides.title: Quality
bullets: Work done to the bioanalytical SOPs, reviewed by the quality manager
Every accession lot carries its own matrix acceptance record
Analyst and study director sign-off recorded on the assay worksheet

slides.title: Contacts
bullets: Business development: Adeel Farooqi, Head of BD North America
DMPK studies: Megan Larkin, DMPK Study Director
Bioanalysis: Javier Quintana, Mass-Spectrometry Manager
Quality: Helen Marchwood, Bioanalytical Quality Manager
